_comment: Five rules today. Change scenario 7 adds Compliance's sixth -- no offer whose instalment exceeds 35% of net monthly income -- as one row plus one registered predicate. The `owner` field on a rule is what lets CODEOWNERS give Compliance approval over row 6 without giving Product approval over it.

rules.description: No offer below the product minimum amount.
No offer whose instalment is below R150.00 -- uneconomic to service.
No offer whose total cost of credit divided by the amount advanced exceeds the threshold.
Scheduled in duplum: no offer whose total interest, fees and premiums over the term exceed the amount advanced.
No offer whose effective annual rate exceeds the suppression ceiling.
